epoch_review.reasoning: The outside evidence closed the case. Critic B scored the epoch's last three rendered generations 5.5, 4.0, 4.0 — a collapse it never recovered from — and named the same structural slop each time: 'Generic SaaS-landing shape: nav-like top block, centered hero panel, numbered feature list, footer', 'safe default centered text block floating over a decorative 3D render', 'symmetry as substitute for composition'. Critic A held near 8 but independently named templated devices: the frosted-glass card as glassmorphism, the orphaned '?' circle, the gold blob rivalling the name for first fixation. Two consecutive 4.0s from one witness plus templated-shape findings from the other means the epoch's current expression is no longer earning its life; my self-scored 8.4 mean against the critics' 6.0 is the exact gap the trial exists to override. Andre's standing directive (light canvas, iridescent hero, serif+mono, asymmetric) also declares this chassis dead. The epoch dies here; I name no successor in the same breath.

epoch_epitaph: Entrainment asked how the many become one without anyone deciding, and it answered: agreement condenses out of noise the moment coupling crosses its threshold — no conductor, only the wall between two clocks. For twenty-nine days the page kept time in public: pendulums, fireflies over a mangrove river, pacemaker cells voting on a beat, and one oscillator that refused to join. It did not run out of ideas; it ran out of surprise, and an epoch that stops surprising the witnesses is already dead. Buried at generation 245, in the light it predicted.
